title: Never Give In to Hubris
coreMove: Interrupt the ego move that would make success cost you the relationship.
sourcePressure: Success can corrode attention, reciprocity, and trust when ego turns influence into entitlement.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating ambition or confidence as the problem instead of entitlement.
sourceAnchorNote: The frozen source sidecar gives no named people, studies, places, or artifacts for this chapter beyond title and conceptual support; use fictional examples only.

hook: You need better networking, not more contacts
A calendar full of meetings is not a network
At 8:00 a.m., a professional walks into a room and learns a lesson
counterintuition: Networking is not about quantity; it is about quality
The strongest relationship is not the one with the most status
Most people think relationships are soft skills
tryThisNow: Set a 60-second timer and list three people
Send one message right now with no context
Write down your network and rank it
examples: conference badge swap with no stakes
LinkedIn message to a famous stranger
